Details & Features
The automatic selector unit enables simultaneous filling of breathing air cylinders via both a storage system and the compressor. Priority is given to the cylinders connected to the filling panel. Only once these are fully filled, the system begins replenishing the storage unit from the compressor. When the maximum storage pressure is reached, the compressor shuts off automatically. A new filling cycle begins as soon as another empty cylinder is connected.
The automatic selector unit performs three key functions:
Pre-filling the breathing air cylinders from the storage system by pressure equalization.
Filling the connected cylinder directly via the compressor until the final filling pressure is reached.
Replenishing the storage system until its maximum pressure is reached.
Options
Pressure regulator
Instead of the standard pressure retention valve, a precise pressure regulator can be selected. It allows stable and exact adjustment of the overflow pressure – ideal for time-critical filling processes with storage systems. Temperature and environmental fluctuations have little effect on its regulation, making it the preferred option.
Scope of delivery
Powder-coated steel mounting plate for wall installation

RECOMMENDED USE
B-SELECT with pressure maintaining valve
The version with pressure maintaining valve is the economical solution for applications with larger pressure
differences (at least 50 bar) between storage and cylinder pressure. It enables simple and cost-effective
connection and is ideal when precise control is not required.
B-SELECT with backpressure regulator
The version with backpressure regulator ensures particularly precise and reproducible filling of the diving
cylinders. The set overflow pressure is maintained at a constant level with a repeat accuracy of ±5 bar, regardless
of the storage or cylinder pressure. This variant is low-maintenance and ideal when precise control behaviour and
a reproducible fast filling process are paramount.
Note: B-SELECT is only available for systems with a fully automatic operating mode!
Subject to technical changes without prior notice.

B-SELECT
Automatic selector unit

For simultaneous filling of pressure cylinders with air from
storage system and compressor
Inlet pressure up to 420 bar
Flow rate up to 850 bar

The automatic selector unit enables compressed air cylinders to be filled quickly and simultaneously in parallel from
a single storage system (buffer) and via one compressor.
Important! The automatic selector unit works most effectively when the nominal pressure in the storage system
and the breathing air cylinder are nearly the same.

HOW IT WORKS
Filling of the breathing air cylinder connected to the filling panel takes priority. This means that the storage system
and the compressor always fill the cylinder connected to the filling panel first. Once the cylinders are completely
filled, the automatic selector unit independently switches over to filling the storage system.

When the maximum filling pressure of the storage system is reached, the compressor shuts down fully
automatically. As soon as the next empty breathing air cylinder is connected to the filling panel, the storage system
again fills the breathing air cylinder first. If the preset restart pressure in the storage system is undershot, the
compressor switches on.
